settings.label: Project ID
settings.meaning: The Descope project the app signs users in to. Its keys verify session tokens, and it goes in every API call's Authorization header.
settings.whereToFind: Console › Project Settings: Project ID. Test and live are separate projects, each with its own ID.

settings.label: Management key
settings.meaning: Lets the server read, create and delete users and set their passwords. Only needed for those calls; never in a browser.
settings.whereToFind: Console › Company settings › Management keys › Generate, with access to this project. Each project (test, live) is reached with a key that covers it.

settings.label: Webhook HMAC secret
settings.meaning: Checks that a webhook came from Descope: the connector signs each body with it. You choose it.
settings.whereToFind: Any long random string of your own, set as the HMAC secret of the Audit Webhook (or HTTP) connector that posts to the app: Console › Connectors.

operations.name: password.signIn
operations.purpose: Signs a user in with their login id (email) and password.

operations.name: password.sendReset
operations.purpose: Emails a user a password reset link; the link's token is verified with magicLink.verify.

operations.name: password.update
operations.purpose: Sets a signed-in user's new password, with their refresh JWT.

operations.name: magicLink.verify
operations.purpose: Verifies a magic link's token (a password reset's) and signs the user in.

operations.name: otp.signUpOrInEmail
operations.purpose: Emails a one-time code to sign in, signing the user up first when the address is new.

operations.name: otp.verifyEmail
operations.purpose: Signs a user in with the emailed one-time code.

operations.name: sessions.refresh
operations.purpose: Exchanges a refresh JWT for a new session JWT.

operations.name: sessions.logout
operations.purpose: Ends the session a refresh JWT belongs to.

operations.name: users.load
operations.purpose: Reads one user by user id, with the management key.

operations.name: users.search
operations.purpose: Searches users, here by email address, with the management key.

operations.name: users.create
operations.purpose: Creates a user with the email as login id, verified or not, with the management key.

operations.name: users.delete
operations.purpose: Deletes a user by user id, with the management key.

operations.name: users.setActivePassword
operations.purpose: Sets a user's password, which they can sign in with as it is, with the management key.

signature.description: The header is the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the connector's HMAC secret. Nothing signs a timestamp or a delivery id, so a captured delivery can be replayed: deduplicating on the signature is the only protection.

events.meaning: A user was created (Audit Webhook connector; each delivery is a JSON array of audit events).
